paragraphs.text: translated by
1. MAY Sovran Indra come to the carousal, he who by Holy Law is strong and active,
paragraphs.original: आ यात्विन्द्रः स्वपतिर्मदाय यो धर्मणा तूतुजानस्तुविष्मान् ।
paragraphs.translit: ā yātvindraḥ svapatirmadāya yo dharmaṇā tūtujānastuviṣmān |

paragraphs.text: The overcomer of all conquering forces with his great steer-like power that hath no limit.
paragraphs.original: प्रत्वक्षाणो अति विश्वा सहांस्यपारेण महता वृष्ण्येन
paragraphs.translit: pratvakṣāṇo ati viśvā sahāṃsyapāreṇa mahatā vṛṣṇyena

paragraphs.text: 2. Firm-seated is thy car, thy Steeds are docile; thy hand, O King, holds, firmly grasped, the thunder.
paragraphs.original: सुष्ठामा रथः सुयमा हरी ते मिम्यक्ष वज्रो नृपते गभस्तौ ।
paragraphs.translit: suṣṭhāmā rathaḥ suyamā harī te mimyakṣa vajro nṛpate gabhastau |

paragraphs.text: On thy fair path, O Lord of men, come quickly: we will increase thy powers when thou hast drunken.
paragraphs.original: शीभं राजन्सुपथा याह्यर्वाङ्वर्धाम ते पपुषो वृष्ण्यानि
paragraphs.translit: śībhaṃ rājansupathā yāhyarvāṅvardhāma te papuṣo vṛṣṇyāni

paragraphs.text: 3. Let strong and mighty Steeds who bear this Mighty Indra, the Lord of men, whose arm wields thunder,
paragraphs.original: एन्द्रवाहो नृपतिं वज्रबाहुमुग्रमुग्रासस्तविषास एनम् ।
paragraphs.translit: endravāho nṛpatiṃ vajrabāhumugramugrāsastaviṣāsa enam |

paragraphs.text: Bring unto us, as sharers of our banquet, the Steer of conquering might, of real vigour.
paragraphs.original: प्रत्वक्षसं वृषभं सत्यशुष्ममेमस्मत्रा सधमादो वहन्तु
paragraphs.translit: pratvakṣasaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ satyaśuṣmamemasmatrā sadhamādo vahantu

paragraphs.text: 4. So like a Bull thou rushest to the Lord who loves the trough, the Sage, the prop of vigour, in the vat,
paragraphs.original: एवा पतिं द्रोणसाचं सचेतसमूर्ज स्कम्भं धरुण आ वृषायसे ।
paragraphs.translit: evā patiṃ droṇasācaṃ sacetasamūrja skambhaṃ dharuṇa ā vṛṣāyase |

paragraphs.text: Prepare thine energies, collect them in thyself: be for our profit as the Master of the wise.
paragraphs.original: ओजः कृष्व सं गृभाय त्वे अप्यसो यथा केनिपानामिनो वृधे
paragraphs.translit: ojaḥ kṛṣva saṃ gṛbhāya tve apyaso yathā kenipānāmino vṛdhe

paragraphs.text: 5. May precious treasures come to us-so will I pray. Come to the votary's gift offered with beauteous laud.
paragraphs.original: गमन्नस्मे वसून्या हि शंसिषं स्वाशिषं भरमा याहि सोमिनः ।
paragraphs.translit: gamannasme vasūnyā hi śaṃsiṣaṃ svāśiṣaṃ bharamā yāhi sominaḥ |

paragraphs.text: Thou art the Lord, as such sit on this holy grass: thy vessels are inviolate as Law commands.
paragraphs.original: त्वमीशिषे सास्मिन्ना सत्सि बर्हिष्यनाधृष्या तव पात्राणि धर्मणा
paragraphs.translit: tvamīśiṣe sāsminnā satsi barhiṣyanādhṛṣyā tava pātrāṇi dharmaṇā

paragraphs.text: 6. Far went our earliest invocation of the Gods, and won us glories that can never be surpassed.
paragraphs.original: पृथक्प्रायन्प्रथमा देवहूतयोऽकृण्वत श्रवस्यानि दुष्टरा ।
paragraphs.translit: pṛthakprāyanprathamā devahūtayo'kṛṇvata śravasyāni duṣṭarā |

paragraphs.text: They who could not ascend the ship of sacrifice, sink down in desolation, trembling with alarm.
paragraphs.original: न ये शेकुर्यज्ञियां नावमारुहमीर्मैव ते न्यविशन्त केपयः
paragraphs.translit: na ye śekuryajñiyāṃ nāvamāruhamīrmaiva te nyaviśanta kepayaḥ

paragraphs.text: 7. So be the others, evil-hearted, far away, whose horses, difficult to harness, have been yoked.
paragraphs.original: एवैवापागपरे सन्तु दूढ्योऽश्वा येषां दुर्युज आयुयुज्रे ।
paragraphs.translit: evaivāpāgapare santu dūḍhyo'śvā yeṣāṃ duryuja āyuyujre |

paragraphs.text: Here in advance men stand anear to offer gifts, by whom full many a work that brings reward is done.
paragraphs.original: इत्था ये प्रागुपरे सन्ति दावने पुरूणि यत्र वयुनानि भोजना
paragraphs.translit: itthā ye prāgupare santi dāvane purūṇi yatra vayunāni bhojanā

paragraphs.text: 8. He firmly fixed the plains and mountains as they shook. Dyaus thundered forth and made the air's mid-region quake.
paragraphs.original: गिरीँरज्रान्रेजमानाँ अधारयद्द्यौः क्रन्ददन्तरिक्षाणि कोपयत् ।
paragraphs.translit: girīm̐rajrānrejamānām̐ adhārayaddyauḥ krandadantarikṣāṇi kopayat |

paragraphs.text: He stays apart the two confronting bowls; he sings lauds in the potent Soma's joy when he hath drunk.
paragraphs.original: समीचीने धिषणे वि ष्कभायति वृष्णः पीत्वा मद उक्थानि शंसति
paragraphs.translit: samīcīne dhiṣaṇe vi ṣkabhāyati vṛṣṇaḥ pītvā mada ukthāni śaṃsati

paragraphs.text: 9. I bear this deftly-fashioned goad of thine, wherewith thou, Maghavan, shalt break the strikers with the hoof.
paragraphs.original: इमं बिभर्मि सुकृतं ते अङ्कुशं येनारुजासि मघवञ्छफारुजः ।
paragraphs.translit: imaṃ bibharmi sukṛtaṃ te aṅkuśaṃ yenārujāsi maghavañchaphārujaḥ |

paragraphs.text: At this libation mayst thou be well satisfied. Partake the juice, partake the worship, Maghavan.
paragraphs.original: अस्मिन्सु ते सवने अस्त्वोक्यं सुत इष्टौ मघवन्बोध्याभगः
paragraphs.translit: asminsu te savane astvokyaṃ suta iṣṭau maghavanbodhyābhagaḥ

paragraphs.text: 10. O Much-invoked, may we subdue all famine and evil want with store of grain and cattle.
paragraphs.original: गोभिष्टरेमामतिं दुरेवां यवेन क्षुधं पुरुहूत विश्वाम् ।
paragraphs.translit: gobhiṣṭaremāmatiṃ durevāṃ yavena kṣudhaṃ puruhūta viśvām |

paragraphs.text: May we allied, as first in rank, with princes obtain possessions by our own exertion.
paragraphs.original: वयं राजभिः प्रथमा धनान्यस्माकेन वृजनेना जयेम
paragraphs.translit: vayaṃ rājabhiḥ prathamā dhanānyasmākena vṛjanenā jayema

paragraphs.text: 11. Brhaspati protect us from the rearward, and from above, and from below, from sinners.
paragraphs.original: बृहस्पतिर्नः परि पातु पश्चादुतोत्तरस्मादधरादघायोः ।
paragraphs.translit: bṛhaspatirnaḥ pari pātu paścādutottarasmādadharādaghāyoḥ |

paragraphs.text: May Indra from the front and from the centre, as Friend to friends, vouchsafe us room and freedom.
paragraphs.original: इन्द्रः पुरस्तादुत मध्यतो नः सखा सखिभ्यो वरिवः कृणोतु
paragraphs.translit: indraḥ purastāduta madhyato naḥ sakhā sakhibhyo varivaḥ kṛṇotu
